prompt: A heavy industrial knife-switch lever thrown home in a concrete plant room: a sharp latch release, then a deep metallic chunk as the steel lever slams into its stop and rings briefly. Close-up, dry.
A large steel lever pulled down into a ratchet catch on a wall panel: one quick ratchet click followed by a solid metal clunk. Close-up, small concrete room, dry.
A spring-loaded steel lever snapping back up: a bright metallic clack as its catch lets go, followed by the short twang of a heavy coil spring. Close-up.
A single heavy electrical relay pulling in inside a steel control cabinet: one dry mechanical click with a short low knock. Close-up.

A massive main circuit breaker in a steel switchgear cabinet tripping right at the microphone: its heavy copper contacts slam open with a loud, deep, violent thunk and a sharp electrical bang. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
An electrical short circuit inside a metal fuse box: a harsh crackling arc that buzzes and stutters for about a quarter of a second, with sharp spark pops. Close-up.
A spray of small electric sparks popping off a freshly cut live wire: rapid bright crackles dying away within a quarter of a second. Close-up.
Steel side-cutter pliers snipping through an insulated copper cable: one crisp, sharp snip as the hardened jaws click shut. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
Electrical power draining out of a large underground facility: a deep transformer whine sagging and falling in pitch to nothing as machines spin down. Ominous, heard in a concrete hall.
Battery emergency lights switching on in a dark concrete corridor: a stuttering fluorescent flicker, then a thin steady ballast buzz that fades out. Medium distance.
Fluorescent ceiling tubes striking on in a laboratory: two or three quick ballast ticks and a faint glassy ping as the tubes light, then a soft hum starting. Overhead, small room.

A heavy steel floor hatch grinding open: an electric motor straining under load while steel leaves scrape and judder against their frame for two seconds, ending in a hard metallic clunk as they lock open. Concrete room.

A heavy steel floor hatch swinging fully open and slamming against its stops: a deep metallic boom with a short rattle of its leaves, then a rush of cold air rising from the shaft below. Close, loud, full level, starting at once.
A pneumatic sliding steel door in a research facility opening: a short burst of air hiss and a smooth sliding whoosh, ending in a soft metallic click as the door stops. Medium distance.
A pneumatic sliding steel door in a research facility closing: a short burst of air hiss, the door sliding shut and a heavy metal thud as it seals against its frame. Medium distance.
A heavy sliding steel bulkhead door shutting in a concrete corridor: a smooth slide, a dull metallic clunk as it meets its frame and the click of its latch. Medium distance.
One loud, close-miked footstep: the rubber heel of a heavy work boot striking a bare concrete floor with a firm thump. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: a work boot rolling from heel to toe on a dusty concrete floor, its rubber sole scuffing the grit. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: a heavy steel-toed work boot landing hard on a concrete floor, a strong heel strike. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: the rubber heel of a heavy work boot striking a linoleum floor laid on concrete, a dull tap with a faint squeak. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: a work boot rolling from heel to toe on a smooth vinyl laboratory floor, a muted tap and a short rubber squeak. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: a heavy work boot landing on a linoleum floor in a small office, a firm, dull heel tap. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: the heel of a heavy work boot striking a steel grating floor, a sharp metallic clank with a short hollow ring. Dry, full level, starting at once.
One loud, close-miked footstep: a work boot rolling from heel to toe on a perforated steel floor panel, a hollow metallic thud and a light rattle of the panel. Dry, full level, starting at once.

One loud, close-miked footstep: a heavy steel-toed work boot slamming down on a steel tread plate, a hard metallic clang with a short ring, hitting full scale. Close, dry, loud, no silence, starting at once.
A handheld two-way radio's push-to-talk key pressed: a short burst of static crackle and a crisp plastic click, narrow walkie-talkie band.
A walkie-talkie transmission ending: the push-to-talk key released with a click and a short squelch tail of static that cuts off abruptly.
A radio channel opening: static swelling up for a third of a second, then snapping shut on a squelch gate click, narrow walkie-talkie band.
A hardboard clipboard holding a few paper sheets set down firmly on a steel desk: a short paper swish, then a solid clack of the board on the metal. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
A thick hardcover operating manual being closed: a rush of air from the pages and a dull soft clap of the cover. Close-up.
A graphite pencil writing fast on a paper notepad lying on a desk: three short, scratchy strokes. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
An industrial alarm klaxon, an electric horn with a vibrating steel diaphragm: two harsh, loud blasts, the second slightly lower. Close, full level, starting at once, a short concrete-hall tail.

A cinematic alarm stinger: a sudden heavy hit of low brass and strings in a dissonant cluster with a short metallic screech over it, swelling for a second and ending abruptly. Loud, full level, starting at once.
A laboratory control console signalling it is ready: a short rising two-tone electronic chirp from a small built-in speaker.
One bright electronic ping from the small piezo speaker of a handheld tablet: a clear, high, short blip. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
One short, dry tick from a handheld radiation detector: a single sharp click of a Geiger counter, close-miked, loud, full level, no tail, starting at once.
A small glass bell struck twice by a metal pin, the second note higher: a warm, clear two-note chime. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
A steel locker door unlatched and swung open: a latch click and the thin rattling clang of its sheet metal. Close-up, small tiled room.
A small padlock opened with a key turn and a bright shackle tick, then a steel drawer rolling out on its runners. Close-up.
A single short electronic countdown beep from a control panel speaker, mid-high pitch, clean and dry.
A longer, higher electronic start beep from a control panel speaker, the final signal of a countdown, clean and dry.
A cartridge fuse pushed firmly into its spring-clip holder in a steel fuse panel: a short scrape and a solid metallic snap as it seats. Close-up.
A small surveillance drone's alarm chirp: two quick rising electronic blips from a tiny speaker.

A small quadcopter surveillance drone flying past close to the microphone: its buzzing rotors rising as it approaches and falling away as it passes, a quick doppler swoosh. Indoors, concrete corridor.
A single hard plastic key on an industrial keypad pressed down: a dry tick with a bright edge. Close-up.
A dull electronic error buzzer on a control panel: one short low rasping buzz lasting about a sixth of a second, small speaker.
A heavy steel bolt sliding home in a security lock: a latch click, then a deep solid thud with a short metallic ring. Close-up.
A short bright major chord on a soft electric piano, strummed quickly upward and ringing out, warm and positive.
A metal toggle switch on a steel control panel flipped over hard: its spring-loaded bat snaps into place with a crisp clack. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.

A large industrial palm push button struck down hard: its spring-loaded plunger slams to the bottom of its steel housing with one loud, low, solid thump and a muffled plastic knock. Recorded close-up and dry at full level, the hit right at the start.
A large red mushroom emergency-stop button slammed down by a palm: its spring-loaded steel plunger latches with a loud, heavy, deep thunk. Close, dry, full level, starting at once.
A multimeter probe tip touching a brass screw terminal: one tiny crisp metal contact click. Close-up.
A glassy electronic two-note chime rising a fifth: a short confirmation tone from a lab instrument.
A metal rotary selector dial turned one step: a soft detent click with a little body. Close-up.
A small bright electronic tick from a handheld device, a cursor moving one step on a display.
A small rubber ball thrown hard against a padded vinyl wall: one solid, dull thud. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
A small incandescent indicator lamp on a steel control panel switching on: its filament catches with one crisp electric pop. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
One short beep from a keypad display accepting a digit, a small piezo speaker, clean.
Two short soft electronic beeps rising, a computer terminal confirming a command, small speaker.
A rack server powering up in its steel chassis: the hard drive motor whining up in pitch over cooling fans spinning up to speed. Close, loud, full level, starting at once.
A faint soft tick of a timer counting one second, very short and quiet.
A single short tick of a rotary volume knob turning one notch on an old radio set: a crisp, dry detent click. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
A strained steel beam creaking slowly in a dark empty building: a groaning metal stress creak. Distant, with room reverb.
A single water drop falling from a steel pipe into a shallow puddle on a wooden floor: one clear plink. Close, loud, full level, starting at once, a soft room tail.
A steel pipe dropped onto a concrete floor far down a long concrete corridor, recorded at full level: a muffled metallic clank with two fading echoes, starting at once.
One slow stroke of a large hydraulic machine piston in a steel frame: a deep heavy thud with a metallic clank and a short hiss of air. Close, loud, full level, starting at once.
Steam escaping from a pressure valve on a pipe: a hiss swelling up and dying away over about a second and a half, in a machine room.
A glass laboratory flask of boiling liquid on a heating plate: a quick run of small bubbles popping. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
A small electromechanical relay inside a steel control console switching over: one crisp mechanical tick of its armature. Close, loud, dry, full level, starting at once.
A deep low throbbing pulse from a reactor core with a faint metallic resonance: it swells up for a third of a second and fades away. Industrial hall.
The steady electrical mains hum of a large facility's power: a 50 Hz transformer hum with soft overtones, constant and even.
An evacuation siren in an industrial facility: two tones alternating high and low at a steady pace, heard from a distance in a concrete hall.
A small quadcopter drone hovering nearby: steady buzzing rotors with a slight flutter, constant.

Server room ambience recorded close at full level: dozens of rack cooling fans whooshing loudly in steel cabinets, a steady 120 Hz transformer hum and the high whine of power supplies, constant and even.
Archive room tone recorded at full level: steady air flowing out of a sheet-metal ventilation duct between wooden shelves, an even, clearly audible soft hiss, constant.
Underground concrete corridor room tone: a low steady ventilation hum and air moving through overhead ducts, constant.

A loud, close recording of a laboratory's machines running at night: a refrigerator compressor's motor humming steadily and a fume hood's exhaust fan roaring through its steel duct, recorded dry at full level, dense and constant, with no gaps.
Reactor hall ambience: a steady deep containment hum at 110 Hz with a soft electrical drone, in a large steel hall, constant.
Control room ambience: a soft hum of console electronics, a faint high whine from screens and quiet air conditioning, constant.
Room tone of a research facility office recorded at full level: steady air from a ceiling ventilation grille and the low 55 Hz hum of the building's transformers, clearly audible, constant.
A dark machine hall without power: the deep low rumble of heavy idle machinery and a faint metallic tick now and then as pipes cool, constant.
A reactor hall during a blackout: a very deep rumble from the core, faint metallic groans and the hiss of residual cooling, ominous, constant.

Room tone of a large research facility at night, heard from its entrance hall: the deep, even hum of distant transformers and heavy ventilation far down the concrete corridors, recorded at full level, clearly audible, constant.

A short triumphant instrumental sting, loud and fully mastered, for a crew that has just escaped a dark research lab: warm strings and brass at full strength from the first beat over a breath of wind, resolving to a bright C major chord that rings out.

A short dark instrumental sting, loud and fully mastered, for a crew that failed to escape a research lab: a heavy low A minor chord on strings and a deep synth drone at full strength from the first beat, one muffled final hit, then a short fade.
